title: A bank account that goes below zero
body: Meena opens a bank account with Rs 100 that she has saved. The next day she earns Rs 60 at her job and deposits it; the passbook shows this as a credit. The day after, she pays an electricity bill of Rs 30 from the account, shown as a debit. The next day she makes a large purchase of Rs 150 for her business, another debit. Her bank allows the balance to become negative for a short time. Her purchase helps her earn Rs 200 at her business the following day, which she deposits as a credit. Treat credits as positive numbers and debits as negative numbers.
